requirements: R1: The system must verify the GitHub PR merge status instead of just the close status before marking a task as done.

slices.title: Patch PR synchronization to verify merge status
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR synchronization patch for this epic, I want to require a true merge flag from GitHub, so that the internal task status accurately reflects non-merged closed PRs.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a closed GitHub PR without a merge event,
When the system synchronizes task statuses,
Then the internal status must remain unchanged,
And unit tests must verify this rejection logic.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce mismatch errors between GitHub and internal task statuses from 100+ to 0
